title.narrative: 3.1.17: Number of Balochistanspecific policeprosecutors coordination forum

description.narrative: 3.1.17: Number of Balochistanspecific policeprosecutors coordination forum Number of Balochistanspecific policeprosecutors coordination forum

comment.narrative: Forum does not exist
01 Forum exists and is functional

Pakistan Prosecution Forum has been consistently discussing among provincial counterparts how to institutionalize an effective mechanism for meaningful cooperation between two pillars of criminal justice. PPF held its last meeting in June 2023 where robust participation from Balochistan police and prosecution was ensured. Second Provincial Justice Committee under the leadership of Chief Justice Balochistan High Court also met in 2023 to discuss strengthening coordination among key pillars of criminal justice system specially police and prosecution. A number of District Criminal Justice Coordination Committees also held their meetings in 2023 to streamline pivotal functionality between police and prosecution. Taking forwards the good work delivered in 2023 UNODC also conducted a dedicated workshop for prosecutors across Pakistan including participants from Balochistan prosecution department. This elaborate training was held in 2023 to reinforce the need to institutionalize provincial mechanisms for strengthened coordination between police and prosecution.
